2608.05785.title: Task-Conditional Flow Matching for Balanced Multilingual Text Embedding Adaptation
2608.05785.paper_summary: Multilingual text embedding models are commonly adapted using a single training objective across diverse tasks, despite different tasks requiring fundamentally different optimization strategies. We introduce Task-Conditional Flow Matching (TCFM), a multilingual embedding adaptation framework that selectively applies Flow Matching to translation tasks while optimizing retrieval, classification, and pair-classification tasks with objectives better aligned to their learning dynamics. TCFM further combines teacher-guided representation preservation with a three-stage curriculum to enable stable adaptation. Evaluated on the Indic Massive Text Embedding Benchmark, TCFM establishes a new state-of-the-art, consistently improving embedding quality across a diverse set of multilingual tasks and generalizing across embedding model families. We will publicly release the codebase and datasets upon acceptance of the paper.
2608.05785.paper_summary_zh: 多語言文本嵌入模型通常使用單一訓練目標來適應不同的任務，儘管不同的任務需要根本不同的優化策略。<lb/>我們介紹了任務條件流匹配（Task-Conditional Flow Matching, TCFM），這是一個多語言嵌入適應框架，選擇性地將流匹配應用於翻譯任務，同時優化檢索、分類和配對分類任務，以更好地與其學習動態對齊的目標。<lb/>TCFM進一步結合了教師引導的表示保留和三階段課程，以實現穩定的適應。<lb/>在印度大規模文本嵌入基準上進行評估，TCFM建立了新的最先進技術，持續改善多樣化多語言任務的嵌入質量，並在嵌入模型家族之間實現泛化。<lb/>我們將在論文被接受後公開發布代碼庫和數據集。
